title: Hunts FH-047S: Confirmed-qualification reader, sponsor invoice and payment sync

source.ref: Split from FH-036..040 (2026-11-10): the pure core, storage and tests shipped dark behind HUNTS_COMMERCE_ENABLED; the live call sites move here.

detail: Read confirmed distinct qualification keys for a Hunt, call decideFreeze and freezeSnapshot once the threshold is met before Hunt end, invoice the frozen amount once (hunt_sponsor_settlements) and mark it paid only from the provider's own reference through nextSettlement, and show publicMoneyLines. Done when: event replay and a fraud correction cannot double invoice, and an unpaid pledge never appears as donations raised. Requires: FH-047, FH-045. Owner role: Finance and game systems.
